hooks.name: Coroner commit gate
hooks.description: Before a shell command runs, blocks git commit, git push and git merge when the Coroner certificate of the migration in .kiro/coroner-scope.json replays as ZOMBIE or invalid, or is missing while the audited COBOL or Java file is staged. A git command replays the certificate (measured 3.7 to 9.9 s with the credit-fees scope); any other shell command passes with no replay (0.17 s). Limit: it does not block file writes, and it reads the command only from tool_input.command of the event. The command runs through scripts/kiro-hook.cmd, which hands over to scripts/kiro-hook in a POSIX shell, and picks the repository virtual environment. With no virtual environment it exits 1 (a warning, not a block). Windows: the owner ran the hooks in the Kiro IDE on Windows on 2026-11-24 with scripts\kiro-hook.cmd; this quoted command form, which also runs in a POSIX shell, was measured on macOS only.
